mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous ultra-low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and low annual inflation (CPIAUCSL annual inflation < 2.5%) indicates stable monetary conditions that reduce equity risk premiums and support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and CPIAUCSL annual inflation < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high housing market regimes (HOUST > 1000), rising residential construction activity signals strong consumer confidence and increased spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong residential sales (RSAFS > 400000) combined with ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) indicates favorable housing market conditions and consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong housing market with low rates
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 400000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained consumer price index level below 235 indicates stable inflation, reducing market uncertainty and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 235.
